title: Santa-hat bat ornament
subtitle: Traced from your wall photo · 50 mm across, 2.4 mm thick, 3 colours · hangs from a small black loop · shown standing as it hangs · millimetres
scale_note: Real size: 50 mm across (your pick). The photo looks along the wall, so the bat appeared squashed sideways; it's stretched 1.23× to undo that (estimated from the round pom-pom).
notes_title: v3: what changed, what to check
notes: v3: 50 mm across, printed in three colours. To keep it in proportion it's 2.4 mm thick, with the brim and pom-pom 0.4 mm proud. The pom-pom (4.5 mm) and loop (4 mm across, 2 mm hole) are a little larger than true scale so the loop still takes thread or a wire hook. At this size the tiny wing-claw spikes smooth out (they'd be under 1.2 mm). Check: the hat and pom-pom size against the bat, and whether 2 mm is a big enough hole for what you'll hang it with.
